name: Legendary Slayer (CR 7)
body:
LEGENDARY SLAYER 8
CR 7

XP 3,200
Ifrit legendary slayer 8
CG Medium outsider (native)
Init +4 Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (armor +4, Dex +4)
hp 46 (8d10-8)
Fort +5, Ref +10, Will +1
Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk cutlass +10/+5 (1d6+1/18-20) or dagger +12/+7 (1d4+1/19-20)
Ranged mwk pistol +13 (1d8/x4) or dagger +12/+7 (1d4+1/19-20)
Special Attacks combat tactics, advanced tactics (sniping +2d8)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 8th, concentration +11)

1/day–burning hands (DC 14)

TACTICS

Before Combat This character will try to learn as much as he can about his target before choosing an approach. Those approaches are usually, assault the enemy, assault the enemy and assault the enemy. He usually takes in his bounties and captures his enemies by attacking them as quickly and furiously as possible. He does not have a lot of capability to ambush or employ special spells or other abilities while on the high seas.

During Combat During combat, this character will single out a leader or powerful spellcaster and focus his fire on them first while directing his crew to engage in melee. The fire wysp companion will bolster everyone’s abilities with its songs and use its spells to debilitate their enemies.

Morale This character is brave and skilled but he is not stupid. He also feels a strong connection to his crew. If the tide is turning and it looks like his crew will be wiped out or if he thinks he can save their life and his, they will retreat or surrender. The captain will only fight to the death if given no other choice or if facing a particularly vile enemy

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 18, Con 8, Int 13, Wis 8, Cha 16
Base Attack +8; CMB +9; CMD 23
Feats Always a Threat B, Deadly Aim B, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (pistol), Gunsmithing, Leadership, Quick Draw B, Rapid Reload, Weapon Finesse B
Skills Acrobatics +9, Bluff +9, Climb +13, Craft (sailmaking) +10, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (geography) +8 (+12 for navigating at sea), Knowledge (local) +5, Lore (sailing) +10, Perception +6, Profession (sailor) +9, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +9, Survival +7, Swim +20; +4 bonus on Appraise, Craft, Knowledge, Lore and Profession checks related to sailing
Languages Common, Aquan, Ignan
SQ evasion, get the job done (day job [sailor], explorer), leadership score (13), slayer talents (combat trick, finesse rogue, graceful athlete, ranger combat style [crossbow])
Gear mwk cutlass, 3 daggers, 2 masterwork pistols, 30 bullets, +1 studded leather armor, feather token (anchor), potion of water breathing, ring of swimming, nautical navigation equipment and maps (325 gp), 49 gp

Legendary Classes: Cloak & Dagger, © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors: Andrew J Gibson, Cerise Herndon, Connor Bates, Jason Nelson, Jeff Lee, Kieran “Kazu” Easter, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Goodall, Mia Yoshida, N. Jolly, Nate Wright, Norman Mitchell, Tara Collins.
